description: SME manufacturing company exploring AI for production optimization (EN test profile)
HAUPTLEISTUNG: Precision manufacturing of industrial components, including CNC machining, quality control, supply chain management, and custom production runs for automotive and aerospace clients.

answers.hauptleistung: Precision manufacturing of industrial components, including CNC machining, quality control, supply chain management, and custom production runs for automotive and aerospace clients.
answers.ki_projekte: Piloting computer vision for quality inspection on one production line. Exploring predictive maintenance solutions for critical CNC machines. Initial conversations with ERP vendor about AI-enhanced demand forecasting.
answers.zeitersparnis_prioritaet: Quality documentation and reporting consume significant engineering time. Manual inspection processes create bottlenecks. Maintenance scheduling relies heavily on experience rather than data. Supplier communication and order tracking require constant follow-up.
answers.geschaeftsmodell_evolution: Moving from pure contract manufacturing toward higher-value services including design consultation, rapid prototyping with AI-optimized parameters, and predictive quality guarantees backed by data.
answers.vision_3_jahre: Establish a smart factory foundation with AI-enhanced quality control, predictive maintenance, and data-driven production planning. Become a preferred partner for clients seeking reliable, data-transparent manufacturing with documented quality metrics.
answers.strategische_ziele: Reduce scrap rate by 30%, implement predictive maintenance across all critical equipment, automate quality documentation, improve delivery reliability to 99%+, and develop data-driven pricing models.
